counterexample.explanation: Active liquidity is L at tick 100 and 0 at tick 50. The repair includes the start tick only when the start is a multiple of the spacing and the end is not. The end tick 50 is also a multiple of 10, so tick 100 is skipped and the result stays L.

summary: The repair sets currentTick to startTick + 1 only when the start tick is a multiple of the spacing and the end tick is not. When both are aligned, an initialized start tick is still skipped, which is why attack P5 still works.
